name: Wonder Festival
blurb: Japan's largest garage-kit and figure event, where sculptors and manufacturers exhibit and sell resin kits at Makuhari Messe each winter and summer.

editions.evidence: Official announcement (wonfes.jp/specialsite/news/news-20377/, via hobby.dengeki.com): 'ワンダーフェスティバル2027[冒]は2日間開催！2027年2月13日（土）。14日（日）に幕張メッセで開催決定' (WF2027[Winter] confirmed for Feb 13-14, 2027 at Makuhari Messe, a two-day format for the first time in 36 years)

notes: WF runs winter (Feb) and summer (Jul) editions; the summer 2026 edition already concluded before this research window. WF2027[Winter] is exceptionally a two-day show (first time in 36 years) per the official announcement. This is a garage-kit/figure sculpting and sales event (circles and manufacturers show and sell kits) rather than a guest-booking convention, so guests is 'none'. Cover uses the current wide promotional banner on the homepage (no edition-specific key art found yet).
